title: My Son Sanctuary, Vietnam: tickets, hours and transport
description: My Son Sanctuary near Hoi An: ticket prices as read in November 2026, the 2026 fee change, show times, the suspended tourist bus, and whether to go with a guide.
h1: My Son Sanctuary in Vietnam: plan your visit, get there and buy the right ticket
intro: My Son Sanctuary is a UNESCO World Heritage site of Cham temple ruins, built from the 4th to the 13th century, about 35 km from Hoi An and 45-50 km from central Da Nang. It is open daily from 06:00 to 18:00, according to its official ticket portal as of November 2026. The tourist bus from Hoi An has been suspended since 15 September 2026, so most visitors go by car, motorbike or tour.
keyPoints: The site is open **06:00-18:00**, and ticket sales run until 17:30, according to the official My Son ticket portal as of November 2026.
On 27 November 2026 the portal listed **{{vnd:150000}}** for foreign visitors, **{{vnd:100000}}** for Vietnamese visitors and a **{{vnd:30000}}** shuttle service ticket.

Da Nang's People's Council set a single visit fee of **{{vnd:40000}}** a person from 21 February 2026 (Resolution 02/2026/NQ-HĐND). Neither page explains how that fee fits with the portal's prices, so check at the counter.
Tourist bus **01DL** (Hoi An - My Son - Cong Troi Dong Giang) was suspended for six months from 15 September 2026.
Go early. The Cham dance shows begin at 09:45, and the official Da Nang tourism portal suggests arriving between 06:30 and 09:00, while it is cooler.

sections.title: Where is My Son Sanctuary in Vietnam?

blocks.text: My Son Sanctuary is in central Vietnam, in hill country south-west of Hoi An. It sits about **35 km from Hoi An** (45 minutes to an hour by road) and **45-50 km from central Da Nang** (about 1 hour 15 minutes to 1 hour 30 minutes), according to [Danang Fantasticity](https://danangfantasticity.com/en/kham-pha/kham-pha-my-son-that-de-gia-ve-khoang-cach-cach-di-tips-huu-ich), the city's tourism portal, as of June 2026.

The site is a group of Hindu temple towers built by the Champa kingdom between the 4th and 13th centuries and dedicated mainly to Shiva. UNESCO inscribed it as a World Heritage site in 1999. In August 1969 United States aircraft bombed the area, and many of the towers are now ruins or partly restored.

**The My Son Heritage Management Board** (Ban quản lý Di sản Văn hóa Mỹ Sơn) runs the site and its [official ticket portal](https://mysonticketonline.vn/information). Older guides place the site in Duy Xuyen district, Quang Nam province. Since the July 2025 provincial merger, the portal's footer gives the address as Thu Bon commune, Da Nang city.

sections.title: My Son Sanctuary ticket prices and what they cover

blocks.text: The official ticket portal lists one price for foreign visitors and a lower one for Vietnamese visitors, plus a separate service ticket for the shuttle. Prices are changing in 2026, so check them on the portal or at the counter on the day.

blocks.caption: Ticket prices on the My Son ticket portal (mysonticketonline.vn), read on 27 November 2026. The portal says the prices include VAT and may change.
rows: Children aged 5 to 15 buy this ticket for the shuttle
Ride the shuttle at no cost

blocks.text: According to Danang Fantasticity, as of June 2026, the ticket covers the temple area, the My Son Museum, the electric shuttle and the Cham cultural performances. The same portal says a guide's commentary costs extra, priced by group size.
Did the My Son entrance fee change in 2026?

Yes, at least on paper. Da Nang's People's Council passed [Resolution 02/2026/NQ-HĐND](https://danang.gov.vn/vi/w/quy-dinh-muc-thu-10000-40000-dong-luot-tham-quan-tai-hoi-an-my-son-va-cac-thap-co) on 11 February 2026. It set the visit fee for My Son at {{vnd:40000}} a person per visit, the same for Vietnamese and foreign visitors, from 21 February 2026. The resolution exempts children under 16 and students, Vietnamese citizens aged 60 and over, Vietnamese citizens with a disability certificate, and diplomatic guests.

Neither the city's page nor the ticket portal explains how this visit fee relates to the higher prices the portal still showed on 27 November 2026. They may be separate charges, such as a state fee and a service charge. Separately, Tuoi Tre reported in January 2026 that the management board planned to propose a single price of {{vnd:250000}} for all visitors. That plan needed council approval, and none of the pages read for this guide confirm it has taken effect.

blocks.title: Check the price before you pay
blocks.text: Tour operators and older blogs quote different prices. Check the total for your group on [the ticket portal](https://mysonticketonline.vn/information) or at the counter. Ask whether the shuttle is included, and whether your child or an older Vietnamese family member is exempt under the 2026 resolution.

sections.title: What time does My Son Sanctuary open?

blocks.text: The site is open every day from 06:00 to 18:00, and tickets are sold from 06:00 to 17:30, according to the official ticket portal as of November 2026. Danang Fantasticity gives 17:00 as the end of ticket sales and museum opening, as of June 2026. Arrive before 17:00 to be safe.

blocks.caption: Opening hours and performances listed on the My Son ticket portal, read on 27 November 2026. Performances pause in bad weather.
rows: 09:00 and 14:45 on the 15th of each month

blocks.text: When is the best time of day to visit?

Early morning is best. Danang Fantasticity suggests arriving between about 06:30 and 09:00, while it is cooler and the light is softer, and the first dance show at 09:45 fits a morning visit. Most of the site is outdoors with little shade, so bring a hat, water and sun cream. In the rainy season, bring a light raincoat.

sections.title: How do you get to My Son Sanctuary from Hoi An or Da Nang?

blocks.text: Right now you can go by car or taxi, by motorbike, or on a guided tour. The dedicated tourist bus is suspended. From Hoi An the trip is about 35 km; from central Da Nang it is 45-50 km.

blocks.caption: Ways to reach My Son Sanctuary. Distances and times from Danang Fantasticity (June 2026); bus status from Danang Bus (notice of 14 September 2026).
rows: Car, taxi or car with driver
Flexible timing. Agree the waiting time and the fare with the driver before you leave
Route through fields and villages. You need a valid licence and must ride in the heat or rain
Price, group size and pick-up vary by operator. Some combine road and a Thu Bon river boat
Suspended for six months from 15 September 2026

blocks.text: Is there a bus to My Son from Hoi An?

Not at the moment. According to a [Danang Bus notice](https://www.danangbus.vn/tin-tuc/tin-tuc/thong-bao-ve-viec-tam-dung-khai-thac-tuyen-xe-buyt-du-lich-hoi-an--my-son--cong-troi-dong-giang-5762.html) dated 14 September 2026, the operator suspended tourist route 01DL (Hoi An - My Son - Cong Troi Dong Giang) for six months from 15 September 2026. Check Danang Bus before relying on it after mid-March 2027.
Can you ride a motorbike to My Son?

Yes, if you are licensed for it. Read [whether your international driving permit is valid in Vietnam](/guides/international-driving-permit-vietnam) and [the motorbike licence rules for foreigners](/teach-in-vietnam/motorbike-licence-in-vietnam-for-foreigners) first. The [motorbike rental guide](/guides/renting-a-motorbike-in-vietnam) covers deposits and the checks to make before you ride out of town.

sections.title: Should you take a guided tour or visit My Son on your own?

blocks.text: Take a guide if you want to understand what you are looking at. Go on your own if you mainly want the early-morning light and to set your own pace. Many towers are ruined, and the site has few signs, so the Champa history mostly comes from a guide.

items: **On your own:** you choose when to arrive, which matters in the heat. You pay the ticket and your own transport, and you can hire a guide's commentary on site for an extra fee priced by group size, according to Danang Fantasticity as of June 2026.
**Group tour from Hoi An or Da Nang:** transport and usually a guide in one booking. Check whether the entry ticket is included, how long you get on site, and whether the timing catches a dance show.
**Private car and guide:** the most flexible option and the most expensive. It suits families or a group that splits the cost.

blocks.text: Tickets and travel offers are sometimes listed under [Tickets and travel on eno.vn](/c/tickets-travel). Compare what each one includes before you pay.

sections.title: How to plan a visit to My Son Sanctuary

blocks.text: Allow a morning. Leave Hoi An or Da Nang early, arrive soon after the site opens at 06:00, and be back by lunch.

items.title: Check the price and hours
items.text: Look at [the official ticket portal](https://mysonticketonline.vn/information) the day before. Prices and fees changed during 2026.

items.title: Choose your transport
items.text: Book a tour, agree a car fare or arrange a motorbike. Do not plan on bus 01DL while its suspension runs.

items.title: Dress for the site and the weather
items.text: The portal asks visitors to dress modestly and not wear shorts or revealing clothes. Wear shoes for uneven outdoor paths and bring a hat, water and rain cover.

items.title: Buy your ticket and take the shuttle
items.text: Buy online or at the office, keep the ticket with you for the gate, and use the service ticket for the electric shuttle.

items.title: Time your walk around a show
items.text: Dance shows near Tower G run at 09:45, 10:30, 11:15, 14:00 and 16:00, and pause in bad weather.

items.title: Follow the site rules
items.text: Do not climb, touch or write on the structures, and do not eat or drink inside the site. You can take photos without flash. Commercial filming needs permission from the board.

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: Hoi An Ancient Town tickets and the other Cham towers covered by the same 2026 resolution. See the [Da Nang city notice](https://danang.gov.vn/vi/w/quy-dinh-muc-thu-10000-40000-dong-luot-tham-quan-tai-hoi-an-my-son-va-cac-thap-co).
Tour operators' prices. These vary by operator and season, and none were confirmed when this guide was checked in November 2026.

faqs.q: Where is My Son Sanctuary in Vietnam?
faqs.a: My Son Sanctuary is in central Vietnam, about 35 km from Hoi An and 45-50 km from central Da Nang, according to the Da Nang tourism portal in June 2026. Since the July 2025 merger, the official ticket portal gives the address as Thu Bon commune, Da Nang city. The site was previously described as being in Quang Nam province. It is a UNESCO World Heritage site of Cham temples.

faqs.q: How much is the My Son Sanctuary ticket for foreigners?
faqs.a: On 27 November 2026, the official My Son ticket portal listed a higher price for foreign visitors than for Vietnamese visitors, plus a separate shuttle service ticket. In February 2026, Da Nang's People's Council also set a single visit fee for all nationalities. How the two fit together is not published, so check the price table in this guide and confirm the total at the counter before paying.

faqs.q: What time does My Son Sanctuary open?
faqs.a: My Son Sanctuary is open every day from 06:00 to 18:00, and tickets are on sale until 17:30, according to the official ticket portal as of November 2026. The Da Nang tourism portal gave 17:00 as the end of ticket sales in June 2026, so arriving before 17:00 is safer. Dance performances run from 09:45 to 16:00.

faqs.q: Is there a bus from Hoi An to My Son Sanctuary?
faqs.a: The Hoi An to My Son tourist bus, route 01DL, was suspended for six months from 15 September 2026, according to a Danang Bus notice dated 14 September 2026. Until the route restarts, visitors reach My Son Sanctuary by taxi or car with a driver, by motorbike, or on a guided tour from Hoi An or Da Nang. Check Danang Bus for the restart date.

faqs.q: Do you need a guide at My Son Sanctuary?
faqs.a: A guide is not required at My Son Sanctuary, but many of the Cham towers are ruins, so a guide explains far more than the site's signs. The Da Nang tourism portal says a guide's commentary can be hired on site for an extra fee priced by group size, as of June 2026. Group and private tours from Hoi An and Da Nang usually include a guide.

faqs.q: What is the best time to visit My Son Sanctuary?
faqs.a: The best time to visit My Son Sanctuary is early morning, roughly 06:30 to 09:00, according to the Da Nang tourism portal, because it is cooler and the light is softer. The first Cham dance show starts at 09:45. The site is mostly outdoors with little shade, so bring water and a hat, and pack a raincoat in the rainy season.

faqs.q: Is My Son Sanctuary worth visiting in Vietnam?
faqs.a: My Son Sanctuary is worth visiting for anyone interested in history. It is a group of Hindu temple towers built by the Champa kingdom between the 4th and 13th centuries and listed by UNESCO in 1999. Bombing in August 1969 destroyed much of the site, so a visit means ruins and restored towers rather than complete temples. Allow a morning from Hoi An or Da Nang.
